title: Morning, the bird and the crow
logline: One of the mornings: the bird and the crow on the same piling, the bird's colors, the crow's black, both looking at the water. The pup below them on the sand. Nobody explains anything.

panels.composition: A dock piling at low tide with a small rainbow bird and a crow perched on it side by side looking at the water, an old three-legged dog on the sand below.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a dock piling at low tide with a small rainbow bird and a crow perched side by side on it looking at the water and an old three-legged dog on the sand below, morning light, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
